s: December 9, 2022 - Patricio Aylwin (born November 26, 1918, Viña del Mar, Chile—died April 19, 2016, Santiago) was a Chilean politician who served as president from 1990 to 1994. He was the country’s first democratically elected president after the 1973 military coup that had brought Augusto Pinochet to power.
